538:t_2:59.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「And so they came to call themselves gods.」

538:t_2:61.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「But a god allows no other god to exist. Therefore gods are fated to fight gods... That is the true battle of the universe...」

538:t_2:62.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「To win it, I must ascend to still greater heights. By taking in you, an existence that has transcended causality.」

538:t_2:64.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「To that end, I changed that woman's fate.」

538:t_2:67.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「Yes. By rights, that woman was fated to die.」

538:t_2:68.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「But with the power I hold, I revived her and allowed her to go on living.」

538:t_2:69.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「Admit it, $$キリコ$$. I am a being who rules even fate... a god.」

538:t_2:70.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「If you wish to protect that woman, obey my will quietly.」

538:t_2:72.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「Yes, $$キリコ$$. That is the fate you cannot resist.」

538:t_2:74.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「I will say it once more, $$キリコ$$. I am a being who rules even fate.」

538:t_2:77.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
「Heh... As expected of you, $$キリコ$$. You made it all the way here.」

538:t_2:78.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「$$ロッチナ$$... You are my eyes and ears. Why are you here?」

538:t_2:79.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
「Wiseman... Are you truly a being who governs fate?」

538:t_2:81.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
「Of course, I too am a man who revered you as a god... I believe I know that power.」

538:t_2:82.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
「I also know that you transferred the people of $$アストラギウス$$ and yourself to this Earth, which becomes the center of all causality.」

538:t_2:84.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「That is correct. The destruction of planet $$モナド$$, which you know of, was an experiment in $$時空震動$$.」

538:t_2:85.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「From its data, I transferred arbitrary humans and myself to this galaxy, which is to become the end of myth.」

538:t_2:86.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
「That power is beyond imagination... Truly worthy of the name of god...」

538:t_2:87.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
「But you too were taken in by $$キリコ$$. Just as I was.」

538:t_2:89.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
「It is true that it was you who saved $$フィアナ$$'s life. But it was $$キリコ$$'s existence that determined your action.」

538:t_2:90.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
「And to make contact with $$キリコ$$, you set your sights on the ambitious $$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$ and set the $$マーティアル$$ in motion.」

538:t_2:91.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
「In other words, your fate is being moved by the existence called $$キリコ$$.」

538:t_2:92.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「Impossible...! I am... a god...! A being that transcends everything!」

538:t_2:93.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
「Yet $$キリコ$$ killed that very you.」

538:t_2:94.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
「$$キリコ$$ denies your existence, but you need $$キリコ$$'s existence... Master and servant have already reversed.」

538:t_2:96.en:
$$キリコ$$
「$$ロッチナ$$ is right, Wiseman. I deny your existence.」

538:t_2:97.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「Stop, $$キリコ$$! What are you doing!?」

538:t_2:99.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「I saved your woman! And yet why...!」

538:t_2:100.en:
$$キリコ$$
「Before that, you toyed with my fate and $$フィアナ$$'s, and now you're trying to make me obey your every whim.」

538:t_2:101.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「Why!? Why won't you obey me!」

538:t_2:102.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「With your power added to mine, winning the True War and overcoming the future of despair would be no mere dream!」

538:t_2:103.en:
$$キリコ$$
「Your dream means nothing to me.」

538:t_2:105.en:
$$キリコ$$
「$$テイタニア$$, huh. Look after $$フィアナ$$ for me.」

538:t_2:106.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「$$フィアナ$$... You were alive.」

538:t_2:107.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
「She's asleep for now, though.」

538:t_2:108.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「Damn you, $$ネクスタント$$...! Heed my command!」

538:t_2:109.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「I no longer have an auxiliary brain.」

538:t_2:110.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「And I am not a $$ネクスタント$$. I am... human!」

538:t_3:3.en: ～ Inside the $$マーティアル$$ Facility ～

538:t_3:7.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
「There's no need to worry. $$フィアナ$$ will slowly be revived like this.」

538:t_3:8.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
「Her consciousness is already close to waking. If you call out to her, it should reach her.」

538:t_3:9.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「I never thought you would side with us.」

538:t_3:10.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
「I am an impartial third party. I take no side and make no enemies. I merely watch where $$キリコ・キュービィー$$'s path leads.」

538:t_3:11.en:
$$キリコ$$
「Wiseman is dead. What do you intend to do now?」

538:t_3:12.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
「Do you truly believe the god is dead?」

538:t_3:14.en:
$$カレン$$
「You! Is that how you're going to threaten $$キリコ$$!?」

538:t_3:15.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
「I have no such intention. My earlier remark was because even I do not grasp the full extent of Wiseman's power.」

538:t_3:16.en:
$$キリコ$$
「Are you saying he's doing the same thing as he did at $$クエント$$?」

538:t_3:17.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
「I am only saying it is possible.」

538:t_3:18.en:
$$キリコ$$
「I have no intention of believing in a future of despair.」

538:t_3:19.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「We are the same as $$キリコ$$. Whatever awaits us in the future, we are prepared to face it.」

538:t_3:20.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「And from what Wiseman told $$キリコ$$, we are beginning to get a vague idea of what these divine beings are.」

538:t_3:22.en:
$$アルト$$
「Are you saying beings like that are the ones who put the $$烙印$$ on us...?」

538:t_3:24.en:
$$宗介$$
「If those beings and the future of despair are connected, what does the fundamental calamity we met at the center of the galaxy mean?」

538:t_3:26.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「But if the true collapse that comes once every 120 million years is drawing near, we will have to face it sooner or later.」

538:t_3:27.en:
$$桂$$
「That doesn't mean we have to be afraid of it.」

538:t_3:28.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Now that we've made up our minds, we just push on and shake off all doubt and fear.」
